name: datacanvas-edu
description: An AI Agent Skill for Synthetic Data Generation in Analytics Education

interface.shortDescription: Create synthetic datasets for analytics education.
interface.longDescription: Turn teaching goals into synthetic business datasets with instructor-defined patterns, verified reference analyses, assignments, and rubrics. The agent guides instructors through Plan, Create, Verify, and Evaluate across business domains, with instructor review of design and acceptance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DataCanvas EDU to create a synthetic dataset for my business analytics class. Help me define a scenario and intended discoveries, then prepare the dataset, checked reference analyses, assignment, and rubric. Ask me for the teaching decisions you need.
